speed_slide.reading: The crossover's worst frame fell 138 -> 103 mm (armed) and 122 -> 68 mm (unarmed); the unarmed walk's worst 58 -> 39 mm. The STEADY RUN's median rose 14.2 -> 22.6 mm/frame (armed) and 19.0 -> 24.1 (unarmed), over 7 planted pairs in T12_8's 2.5 s against 15-16 in T12_9's. The same pair rule (the lower toe within 3 cm of its lowest, height change <= 1 cm) on the RAW run clips at the drive speed (5.141 m/s, 1/24 s, 8 start phases, 60 rows): T12_8 ~19 pairs at 20.9 mm, T12_9 ~16 pairs at 18.6-20.3 mm. So T12_9 in the scene reads as its clip does (16 pairs, 22-24 mm) and it is T12_8's in-scene baseline that read LOW against its own clip (7 pairs, 14-19 mm) -- not explained. The median is toe roll, not drive-speed slide: the foot-lock speed at the clip's own keys (57_footlock.py) is 5.196 m/s on the toes against the drive speed 5.141 (1.1%, ~2.3 mm/frame)

sword_gate.does_the_roll_hold: NO. The roll does not change the blade's tilt, lean or reach (a turn about weapon_r's +Y; the sword's axis is 0.08 deg off +Y): the same 6 of 6 holds pass at both rolls. It turns the edge: holds move from -3..-31 to +10..+34 (both inside 45) and the strikes' edges go from leading (+0.96..+0.99) to 45-50 deg off the cut (FAIL). At roll 0 the sword's edge sits exactly where the axe's does -- the frame convention is shared (+Z an edge) -- so the axe's re-solved guard already carries it
sword_gate.why_the_D2_instrument_asked_for_it: The two instruments agree on the POSE (their idle tilt 54.36 / fwd 0.287 / out 0.76 against 54.4 / 0.28 / 0.76) and on the SWORD'S FRAME (widest spread vs marker: 0.4 deg in weapon_r's frame, both +Z). An importer-free numpy evaluation of the GLB reproduces the Godot number (T12_5 idle_guard, weapon_r +Z heading -6.3 deg in both). Their readings at BOTH rolls (-48.4 at 0, -22.4 at -39) are reproduced to 0.1 deg by the marker's edge turned 70 deg about the blade: their world-space 'widest spread' is not the edge. The -39 roll corrects their instrument, not the sword. Its exact mechanism in the Blender evaluation is not found
